shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "cat AGENTS.md && printf '\\n--- spec candidates ---\\n' && ls specs && printf '\\n--- dod ---\\n' && cat .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "cat specs/hal-engine-tool-responses/spec.md && printf '\\n--- registry ---\\n' && cat src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && printf '\\n--- tests nearby ---\\n' && ls src/orchestration/tools && sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/tools/*.test.ts 2>/dev/null && printf '\\n--- commands ---\\n' && cat .lore/test-commands.yml && printf '\\n--- git ---\\n' && git status --short --branch"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "cat .lore/test-commands.yml && cat package.json && sed -n '1,140p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && cat src/types/ai.ts | sed -n '1,100p'"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'rg -n "spec:|specs/.+#|validated by:" src specs | head -40 && rg --files src/orchestration | head -30 && git branch --show-current && git remote -v'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short && git diff --check && git diff -- .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && git log -1 --oneline'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "test(tools): define input validation acceptance" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
